attributions.title: Add fractions with unlike denominators

exercise.instruction: Add each pair of fractions. Give every answer in lowest terms.

paragraphs: Find a denominator both fractions can use.
Rename each fraction without changing its value.
Add the numerators and keep the shared denominator.
lesson.title: The three moves

steps: Rewrite both addends as equivalent fractions.
Add the numerators and reduce if needed.
